interpretation_boundary: Unseen Test estimation only; no post-Test tuning. Human answer-quality scores cover only the frozen review packet; Judge-human agreement is not available because the Test Judge was not run.

review_denominator_contract.n_evaluable: successful rows with a visible answer
review_denominator_contract.n_non_evaluable: generation failures; human answer-quality scores must remain null
review_denominator_contract.n_not_applicable: retrieval-only rows or successful pre-generation refuse/clarify decisions
